about: Computed by Art/Models/Terrain/RansomsRest.py from layout.json (run it with --computed). Unreal world centimeters (X north, Y east, Z up); yaw in degrees (0 = +X, 90 = +Y). Terrain heights are the built terrain's, with the area placed at the origin.

macroMap.uv0: U = (Y + 20000) / 40000, V = (X + 20000) / 40000 (V up from the bottom of the image, as in Blender; north is up in the image)
macroMap.alpha: detail selector: about 0 grass and soil, 1 rock; dirt roads about 0.4, footpaths 0.25, scree 0.65 (never exactly 0: the lowest value is 1/255)

scatterMap.uv0: same square and mapping as the macro map
scatterMap.R: tree density: high in the forest grove, a few lone trees in open meadow; 0 on roads and paths (+1.5 m), water, rock, building footprints, the village square, the farmyard, the target meadow and the orchard (its trees go on orchardRows)
scatterMap.G: grass density: 1 in meadows; 0 on road and path surfaces (soft 1 m edge), water, steep rock, footprints and bare dirt; about 0.4 under the forest canopy
scatterMap.B: flower density: big drifts in the meadows, 0 where G is 0, sparse in the forest
scatterMap.A: pebbles and small rocks: a thin band just outside road edges, cliff feet (scree), the rim, the creek banks; 0 elsewhere

bridge.note: location is the middle of the span at deck height (the road surface on both banks); yaw runs along the road; span is bank to bank plus a meter each side

waterfall.note: the lip: where the creek falls into its gorge, at the water surface; yaw is the flow direction

keepersBridge.note: location is the middle of the span at deck height (the road surface on both banks); yaw runs along the road; span is bank to bank plus a meter each side

dryWash.note: points run along the bed (z is the bed), down to its end

millCreek.note: the lip: where the creek falls into its gorge, at the water surface; yaw is the flow direction

ringMap.note: the surround ring's macro color map (its meshes' UV 0); the core's blends into it across the seam band

region.note: the core is the map square; its outer seamBand fades into the regional field, so the core meets the surround ring there without a crack

boundary.note: APlayableArea's corners (world cm; Z is the ground at the corner, or the nearest ground on the core within 2 m for a corner on an open edge, which stands out over a drop) and open_edges (edge i runs from corner i to corner i + 1, the last back to corner 0; true where a drop is part of play)

rise.note: past every rock edge (closed, neither open nor blocked), every step cm along it: the rise from the line to run cm out as an angle (degrees), where the ground first gets steeper than walkable (cm out), and whether the line drops off the core; terrain_check.py holds each rise above walkable and each foot within the within cm where the layout asks for the rule (boundary.foot)

openGround.note: distances (cm) from walkable ground inside the boundary to its nearest break: largest is the widest empty circle's radius; worst lists the centers of the emptiest stretches (one per stretch); overTarget is the share of walkable ground farther than target from a break
